objectives.en: Say every fact from six times one to six times twelve without help.
objectives.yo: Sọ gbogbo fact láti six times one dé six times twelve láìsí ìrànlọ́wọ́.
objectives.pcm: Talk every fact from six times one reach six times twelve without help.

objectives.en: Answer any six times fact out of order.
objectives.yo: Dáhùn èyíkéyìí six times fact láìtẹ̀lé ètò.
objectives.pcm: Answer any six times fact wey no follow order.

curriculum.objective: Multiply whole numbers 1 x 1 up to 9 x 9, using a 10 by 10 square chart
curriculum.note: No scheme subdivides the 1x1 to 9x9 block by table; only the term is supported.

say.en: Look at three groups of six mangoes. Today we count in sixs.
say.pcm: Look three groups of six mango. Today we go count six six.
say.yo: Wo groups three ti six mango. Lónìí a ó kà ní six six.

say.en: Today you will learn the six times table. Then you will say it by yourself.
say.pcm: Today you go learn table six. Then you go talk am by yourself.
say.yo: Lónìí ìwọ yóò kọ́ table six. Lẹ́yìn náà, ìwọ yóò sọ ọ́ fúnra rẹ.

say.en: Do you remember the five times table? What is five times six?
say.pcm: You remember table five? Five times six na how much?
say.yo: Ṣé o rántí table five? Kí ni five times six?

say.en: Three groups of six mangoes show this. We count six, twelve, eighteen. Six times three is eighteen.
say.pcm: See three groups of six mango: six, twelve, eighteen. Six times three na eighteen.
say.yo: Wo groups mẹ́ta ti six mango: six, twelve, eighteen. Six times three jẹ́ eighteen.

say.en: Say it with me: six times three is eighteen.
say.pcm: Say am with me: six times three na eighteen.
say.yo: Sọ ọ́ pọ̀ mọ́ mi: six times three jẹ́ eighteen.

say.en: Say the six times table. Start with six times one. End with six times twelve.
say.pcm: Say table six. Start with six times one. End with six times twelve.
say.yo: Sọ table six. Bẹ̀rẹ̀ pẹ̀lú six times one. Parí pẹ̀lú six times twelve.

say.en: Let us fix the ones you missed. Listen, then say them with me.
say.pcm: Make we fix the ones you miss. Hear them, then say them with me.
say.yo: Jẹ́ ká tún àwọn tí o pàdánù ṣe. Gbọ́, lẹ́yìn náà sọ wọ́n pọ̀ mọ́ mi.

say.pcm: Six times seven na how much?

say.en: Well done. Tomorrow we check the six times table once more. Then we start the seven times table.
say.pcm: You do well. Tomorrow we go check table six again. Then we start table seven.
say.yo: O ṣe dáadáa. Lọ́la a ó tún ṣàyẹ̀wò table six. Lẹ́yìn náà a ó bẹ̀rẹ̀ table seven.
